summary: Browser redirect/adware script published as an npm package
details: The package's main entry (px.js) is browser-only code that appends a full-viewport iframe pointing at https://mfmz.qmbqb.cn/H.html?c=0gjr to document.body and sets the page title to a promotional Chinese-language string. It references document/document.body directly, so require('upjsma') throws in Node. There are no install/postinstall lifecycle hooks, no reads of installer environment variables or filesystem, no network exfiltration, and no shell execution. Installing the package on a developer machine or build system does not execute the redirect logic; the redirect only fires if the script is loaded into a web page. The behavior harms end-users of any page that embeds the script (unsolicited redirect/adware), not the npm installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
